references.text: Describes the descendants of Kohath among the Levites, who are the same ones who receive cities in Joshua 21:5
Parallel text listing the ten cities given to the remaining Kohathites from the tribes of Ephraim, Dan, and half-tribe of Manasseh
Mentions Kohath as one of Levi's sons and provides background for the Kohathite lineage
Lists the Kohathite clans who later received cities by lot
Detailed list of the specific cities that the Kohathites received from the tribes of Ephraim, Dan, and Manasseh
